Regarding the physical therapy techniques described for lateral epicondylitis (tennis elbow), the plan is highly effective and aligns with current clinical best practices. Eccentric strengthening exercises for the wrist extensors are considered the gold standard in conservative management for this condition, as they promote collagen remodeling and improve tendon load tolerance. Manual therapy can help reduce pain and improve joint mobility, while ice therapy is appropriately used post-exercise to manage acute inflammation and pain. This multimodal approach addresses both the mechanical dysfunction and the inflammatory component of the injury.
